scope: The semantic frontend checks source types, retains operations/result-pointer writes, and folds GNU predicate constants. It does not generate overflow machine code. Native C executions establish compiler behavior used by the semantic contract.

Generic first operands preserve their own integer types. Typed forms use target-specific int/long/long-long prototypes. GCC accepted pointer/qualifier conversions are retained as IntrinsicArgument; the compiler is invoked without warning-as-error flags.
Clang rejects GNU _p names. Its generic Boolean result uses one-bit mathematical precision despite its eight-bit object representation; GCC rejects generic Boolean/enum result pointers.

GNU predicate result-expression values are ignored, but volatile reads, increments and VLA-bound evaluation remain effects. Predicates honor written bitfield precision, including GNU enum bitfields. Unsupported or unproven constant cases produce diagnostics or remain runtime expressions.

Predicate folding requires constant first operands and provably absent effects from the ignored third value. Store forms are never evaluated as constant expressions. This is not a claim of complete compiler optimizer folding equivalence.

The final integrated predicate implementation is compared with GCC through 1215 compile-time assertions. Four x86_64 Linux native executions cover GCC/Clang at O0/O2, all eighteen typed stores, mixed signed/unsigned generic stores, volatile writes, Clang Boolean/enum results and GNU predicate effects.
Cross-target Clang checks compile LLVM IR; they are not native execution on macOS, ARM or Windows. Native matrix checks are also available as ignored integration tests for CI.

Full SQLite 3.45.1 and libgit2 alloc/repository inputs are unchanged from the pinned source audit. All three pass both GCC-preprocessed and Toucan-preprocessed routes in ordinary/retained modes, and each route has identical complete translation-unit hashes. The compiler profiles select different preprocessor branches, so units are compared within a route, not between routes.

Source checks use explicit two-million preprocessing-token/node, eight-million edge and 128MiB retained-payload limits from corpus/translation-units.json. Input requests differ only in output paths. Timings and peak RSS are single-run resource observations, not stable performance benchmarks.

Default semantic allocation samples are identical to fb23dac. The new predicate memoization map allocates only for predicate checks and is capped at 65536 entries. The twenty-level nested predicate check is a boundedness regression, not a benchmark.
The retained graph helper checks arena/link invariants for nine target/seed cases; no new sanitizer campaign is claimed by this evidence. C11 _Atomic type support remains a separate task.
